Name: No Year 2 Price Increase Clint
Author: 4ihdf66
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Ore and Coal Price No Increase
Compatible with 1.6+, 1.6.15 tested

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Requirements  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
Copy files to "Stardew Valley\Mods\"

[b]Main features[/b]
This mod does not work by fixing the prices of the original Ore and Coal ;
instead, it adds new items to the very bottom of the item list in Blacksmith shop.

If you scroll the list down to the bottom, you will see the newly added Ore and Coal , as my sample image, which are available at a fixed price of Gold Ore 400g; Coal 150g; Iron Ore 150g; Copper Ore 75g.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
